title: The finite-precoverage site-system strictification interface is false
statement: The proposition stated by CategoryTheory.exists_site_system_strictification_data in lem-weil-pbc-site-system-strictification-data, specialized to object and morphism universes zero, is false. Equivalently its complete universally quantified signature, including every input hypothesis and every output clause, has a proved negation. The counterexample has I=WithTop Nat, C_i=Codiscrete PUnit, P_i the top precoverage, identity transition functors, D=Codiscrete I, and v_i constant at i.

source.place: Precoverage.HasIsos and Precoverage.IsStableUnderBaseChange, lines 85–101; counterexample to the strictification interface sourced from Categories Tag 004A

proof.text: Construct the singleton codiscrete category and its top precoverage. All axioms hold because all presieves cover; all coverings are finite because the type of arrows into any object is finite. Isomorphism pullback squares give all pullbacks.

Set I=WithTop Nat, every C_i to the singleton category and every U_ij to identity. Take gamma to be eqToIso of the identity-composition equality. Identity morphism preservation, continuity and finite-limit preservation follow from the identity-functor instances. The sheaf pullback construction is isomorphic to the abstract left adjoint and therefore preserves finite colimits.

Take D=Codiscrete I and v_i constant at i. The unique natural isomorphisms supply delta. Identity normalization is equality of isomorphisms after id-comp; the cocycle equations are equalities in singleton hom types. This verifies every input of the original signature.

Apply the hypothetical strictification conclusion to these data and extract Q HasIsos, Q indexed base-change stability, finite coverings, e equivalences and the two strict coefficient equalities. Apply lem-weil-pbc-site-system-strictification-obstruction to obtain False.

proof_origin.place: Indexed base-change axiom; explicit counterexample and Lean proof written by N2

mathlib_searches.query: In a finite precoverage stable under arbitrary indexed base change, an injective family of objects isomorphic to a fixed object is finite
mathlib_searches.results: Precoverage.finite, Precoverage.mem_finite_iff, Precoverage.ofArrows_mem_finite and Pretopology.finite; none supplies the obstruction. The finite precoverage has HasIsos but has no indexed IsStableUnderBaseChange instance.
mathlib_searches.verdict: No matching obstruction or refutation; proof uses the indexed axiom directly.

mathlib_searches.results: CategoryTheory.Precoverage.mem_coverings_of_isPullback (Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Sites.Precoverage), with arbitrary indexing type and chosen pullback squares.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Used in the proved obstruction helper, not an exact match to the new statements.

mathlib_searches.results: Only an unrelated finite-character hit in Order.TeichmullerTukey; repo strictification search found only the original holed interfaces.

theorem site_system_strictification_data_refuted : ¬ (∀
    (I : Type 0) [Preorder I] [Nonempty I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (C : I → Cat.{0, 0}) (P : ∀ i : I, Precoverage (C i))
    [∀ i, (P i).HasIsos] [∀ i, (P i).IsStableUnderComposition]
    [∀ i, (P i).IsStableUnderBaseChange] [∀ i, (P i).HasPullbacks]
    (hfinite : ∀ (i : I) (X : C i) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P i X → Finite R.uncurry)
    (U : ∀ (i j : I), i ≤ j → C i ⥤ C j)
    (hUid : ∀ i : I, U i i le_rfl = 𝟭 (C i))
    (gamma : ∀ (i j k : I) (h : i ≤ j) (h' : j ≤ k),
      U i j h ⋙ U j k h' ≅ U i k (h.trans h'))
    (hgammaLeft : ∀ (i k : I) (h : i ≤ k),
      HEq (gamma i i k le_rfl h) (Iso.refl (U i k h)))
    (hgammaRight : ∀ (i k : I) (h : i ≤ k),
      HEq (gamma i k k h le_rfl) (Iso.refl (U i k h)))
    (hgamma : ∀ (i j k l : I) (h : i ≤ j) (h' : j ≤ k) (h'' : k ≤ l) (X : C i),
      (gamma j k l h' h'').hom.app ((U i j h).obj X) ≫
          (gamma i j l h (h'.trans h'')).hom.app X =
        (U k l h'').map ((gamma i j k h h').hom.app X) ≫
          (gamma i k l (h.trans h') h'').hom.app X)
    (hcover : ∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j) (X : C i) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P i X → R.map (U i j h) ∈ P j ((U i j h).obj X))
    (hpullback : ∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j) (X Y Z : C i) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P i X → ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
        PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (U i j h))
    [∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j), (U i j h).IsContinuous
      (P i).toGrothendieck (P j).toGrothendieck]
    [∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j), PreservesFiniteLimits
      (sheafPullback (U i j h) (Type 0) (P i).toGrothendieck (P j).toGrothendieck)]
    [∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j), PreservesFiniteColimits
      (sheafPullback (U i j h) (Type 0) (P i).toGrothendieck (P j).toGrothendieck)]
    (D : Type 0) [Category.{0} D] (v : ∀ i : I, C i ⥤ D)
    (delta : ∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j), U i j h ⋙ v j ≅ v i)
    (hdeltaId : ∀ i : I, HEq (delta i i le_rfl) (Iso.refl (v i)))
    (hdelta : ∀ (i j k : I) (h : i ≤ j) (h' : j ≤ k) (X : C i),
      (v k).map ((gamma i j k h h').hom.app X) ≫
          (delta i k (h.trans h')).hom.app X =
        (delta j k h').hom.app ((U i j h).obj X) ≫ (delta i j h).hom.app X)
    ,
    ∃ (F : I ⥤ Cat.{0, 0}) (Q : ∀ i : I, Precoverage (F.obj i))
      (e : ∀ i : I, C i ⥤ F.obj i),
      (∀ i : I, (e i).IsEquivalence) ∧
      (∃ (_ : ∀ i, (Q i).HasIsos) (_ : ∀ i, (Q i).IsStableUnderComposition)
        (_ : ∀ i, (Q i).IsStableUnderBaseChange) (_ : ∀ i, (Q i).HasPullbacks),
        (∀ (i : I) (X : F.obj i) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ Q i X → Finite R.uncurry) ∧
        (∀ (i : I) (X : C i) (R : Presieve X),
          R ∈ P i X ↔ R.map (e i) ∈ Q i ((e i).obj X)) ∧
        (∀ (i : I) (X : F.obj i) (K : Type 0) (A : K → F.obj i)
          (f : ∀ a : K, A a ⟶ X), Presieve.ofArrows A f ∈ Q i X →
          ∃ (Y : C i) (B : K → C i) (g : ∀ a : K, B a ⟶ Y)
            (t : (e i).obj Y ≅ X) (s : ∀ a : K, (e i).obj (B a) ≅ A a),
            Presieve.ofArrows B g ∈ P i Y ∧
              ∀ a : K, (e i).map (g a) ≫ t.hom = (s a).hom ≫ f a) ∧
        (∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j) (X : F.obj i) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ Q i X →
          R.map (F.map (homOfLE h)).toFunctor ∈
            Q j ((F.map (homOfLE h)).toFunctor.obj X)) ∧
        (∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j) (X Y Z : F.obj i) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ Q i X →
          ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
            PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (F.map (homOfLE h)).toFunctor) ∧
        ∃ (_ : ∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j), (F.map (homOfLE h)).toFunctor.IsContinuous
            (Q i).toGrothendieck (Q j).toGrothendieck),
          (∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j), Nonempty (PreservesFiniteLimits
            (sheafPullback (F.map (homOfLE h)).toFunctor (Type 0)
              (Q i).toGrothendieck (Q j).toGrothendieck))) ∧
          (∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j), Nonempty (PreservesFiniteColimits
            (sheafPullback (F.map (homOfLE h)).toFunctor (Type 0)
              (Q i).toGrothendieck (Q j).toGrothendieck))) ∧
          ∃ (theta : ∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j),
              e i ⋙ (F.map (homOfLE h)).toFunctor ≅ U i j h ⋙ e j)
            (v' : ∀ i : I, F.obj i ⥤ D),
            (∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j), (F.map (homOfLE h)).toFunctor ⋙ v' j = v' i) ∧
            (∀ i : I, e i ⋙ v' i = v i) ∧
            (∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j) (X : C i),
              Arrow.mk ((v' j).map ((theta i j h).hom.app X)) =
                Arrow.mk ((delta i j h).inv.app X))))
